quest.title: The Ancient Azure Stars
quest.description: Without the need for further divination, everyone heads to the final island in search of the next mirage.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Everyone, over here!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Is everyone awake now? Mona says that she has something important to tell everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: The first glimmering daybreak after the return of the Immernachtreich most certainly revitalizes one's innermost spirits.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: What mein Fräulein means is that she is ready to take on the next challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, we're rested and ready too!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Alright. Then I'll get to the crux of the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I just peeked into my scryglass, and there's a new mirage forming on the island over there.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: And... I have a feeling that this one is my mirage.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh, so now it's Mona's turn. You were with us for all of ours, seems like it's time for us to go with you into yours!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ugh... well, I'm sure there's nothing to see, really.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Lady Megistus, are you embarrassed?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: No, absolutely not! Haha... It's not like I'm worried about everyone judging me after seeing my embarrassingly pathetic mirage or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This emphatic "no" sounds rather like a thinly disguised "yes"...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Well... *ahem* Astrologists are often regarded as something out of this world, right? But what if my mirage is nothing like that...?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Fret not. Your Prinzessin is not so foolish as to entertain preconceived notions on how thy mirage should or should not present itself.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Yeah, me neither! Not that I have low expectations of you, Mona, but personally, I think you're a kind soul, and you shouldn't feel like you have to live up to anything more than that.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I'm sure Mona's mirage will stay true to her kind heart.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, and it's not like we're going in there just to do some sightseeing. There's other reasons, too, right?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I suppose I'm not worried as long as everyone doesn't get too excited. Alright then, let's get going.

choices.text: ...we'll find some clues about the unusual phenomena there.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: According to my scryglass, we've arrived at the mirage. Okay, let's find the entrance first...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is that it, over there?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Huh, this looks like some kind of pool.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, we're not gonna have to swim to get in, are we?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Wait, do we have a non-swimmer among us?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: No, I don't think that's the real problem here...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ahaha, someone's scared, huh? Well, then, I'll go first.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: And there she goes! She's gonna show off her oh-so-perfect swimming skills now!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Ahem! Please be mindful of your wording, mein Fräulein.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ohh! Right!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: See you later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, Mona dived right into the pool and disappeared! Let's catch up with her!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: What a spectacular structure...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Wow, I've never seen anything like this...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey, uh Mona, your mirage is amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Though it falls short of the glorious Immernachtreich, one must admit that it is an impressive realm nonetheless, Lady Megistus.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: (Whew, at least it's not showing me getting lectured by the old hag. Thank goodness...)

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Well, what else would you expect of a genius astrologist's mirage?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Okay, let's get started.

talks.objective: Follow the star to the destination
Pass the challenge of the starry sky

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Lady Megistus... this is heartbreaking.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Ugh, please don't try to comfort me. It'll only make me feel embarrassed...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: C'mon, you don't need to pretend in front of us! Need a hug?

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: N—No!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: That was really how I felt back when I first started out in astrology but...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I've matured now. I'm no longer so easily swayed by random people's opinions.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Who would've thought! Even Megistus the Court Archmage was not spared of vexatious times in her career.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It must have been difficult to be misunderstood by others... I'm glad that you were able to move past that.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Actually, there are many who have given up astrology due to similar circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: But, I am a genius, so it's only fair that I'm able to accomplish what others cannot.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's pretty inspiring to hear you say all that in an amazing place like this!

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Ahem... sorry to interrupt, but the door is that way.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Alright, I'll let you shower me with praise after all the mysteries are solved.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: The surroundings appear to have changed. This isn't the beach we originally left.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: The area appears to be the mountains of Mondstadt. Wait, have we been sent back to Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Yet the boundless ocean still surrounds us.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: There should be another pool around here for us to enter.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Over here, y'all!

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Hmm? Why isn't it letting us enter?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, something seems to be floating on the water there...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Uh... is it a painting? Or what is it...?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It seems to be hinting at a specific place.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: It is anticipating that the Prinzessin would guide her loyal followers to the location that has been chosen by fate.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Why is it always you that has to take the lead... Ugh whatever, it doesn't matter. Let's just find this place first.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm? There's a star over there...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And now it's gone! Let's follow it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It made its way inside!
